prompt: State the two essential physical conditions required for the kinematic equations of motion (suvat equations) to be valid.
hints: Consider both the path geometry and the behaviour of the acceleration vector.
solution:
1. Motion must be in a straight line.
2. Acceleration must be constant (uniform) in both magnitude and direction.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Note that suvat equations assume motion along one coordinate axis.
Step 2: Note that acceleration a is treated as a single constant number.

mark_scheme.criterion: States straight-line motion AND constant / uniform acceleration (in magnitude and direction)
